catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits a fire-and-forget trajectory_msgs/msg/JointTrajectory publication. cap.motion.joint_position.v1 takes a flat joint_positions array and requires reached and joint_positions outputs; the pinned topic carries an array of JointTrajectoryPoint objects and has no controller acknowledgement or reached measurement. cap.motion.stop.v1 is a stop class, not this command. The extension preserves the native message shape and reports only published/confirmed.
catalogue_requests.summary: Publish one JointTrajectory to /arm_controller/joint_trajectory as a transmission-only command.

notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the primary arm control is implemented and fake-tested, but the pinned clone exposes no source-backed stop, pause, cancellation or safe-state service or action for the trajectory controller, so a RosDriver cannot prove a safe state. Last gate run 2026-11-05T09:22:33Z, backend fake, report digest sha256:c5a94cbcf5c08e148727f733ac0a131ac220d001cd46c7992d57718cbbb770d5: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour with G6.ESTOP_FAILED (status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED; the latch stays engaged); G7 pass Native surface; G8 fail Protocol and surface with G8.CONFORMANCE (MHS-Sim CL3 not achieved, level CL1; failing required tests TCAP-003 and SAFE-028) and G8.TEST for both; G9 skip G9.NOT_RUN. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. The pinned clone stayed unmodified (G1 pass).

SCOPE AND SOURCE EVIDENCE: the selected interface is the upstream's own six-joint trajectory publication on /arm_controller/joint_trajectory (hackathon_ws/hackathon_ws/src/so101_gazebo/scripts/object_detector.py:14, with the trajectory_msgs import at :5 and the six-joint order at :30-38). The launched Gazebo path uses config/controllers.yaml, whose arm_controller is a joint_trajectory_controller/JointTrajectoryController over shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll and gripper (controllers.yaml:9-20) and sets open_loop_control true (:25); the launch starts ros2_control_node with that file (launch/so101_gazebo.launch.py:204-211) and spawns the controllers (:271-282). The action x-cap.shouryash007.arm_trajectory.v1 publishes one trajectory_msgs/msg/JointTrajectory with the fixed six-joint order and maps points[*] to the native trajectory.points array. Its output is published=true and confirmed=false: a rosbridge publication reports transmission only, never controller receipt, interpolation, motion, arrival or a stopped state. The upstream script publishes the scanning pose ten times at 0.1 s then waits 5 s (object_detector.py:41-46) and publishes one nine-point grasp trajectory (object_detector.py:77-138); these are script behaviours, not bounds.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the clone has no stop or pause ROS service or action for the arm. So101GazeboBridge.stop only clears its running flag and closes the UDP socket (so101_gazebo_bridge.py:108-110); it does not stop a trajectory the external controller has already accepted. The teleop bridge's process_command also fills a missing arm joint with 0.0 (so101_gazebo_bridge.py:72-106), so it is not a safe-state path. The Gazebo world-control service and the controller-manager switch service are outside the clone and are not bridged by the upstream launch. MoveIt's config names FollowJointTrajectory with an action_ns (so101_moveit_config/config/moveit_controllers.yaml:10-25) but never writes the resolved action endpoint or the control_msgs type, and pick_place_test.py builds a MoveGroup goal without sending it (:20-51). No safe_state action, safe-state binding, estop_physical_ref or e-stop binding is declared; the runtime software latch refuses new publications but cannot interrupt an accepted trajectory. This is a genuine upstream stop gap, not a missing fake feature. The fake is not made to complete instantly and no stop is claimed as proven.

LIMITS: the six position bounds are the revolute travel ranges in the pinned URDF, in controller order: shoulder_pan -1.91986..1.91986 rad (so101.urdf:495-500), shoulder_lift -1.74533..1.74533 (:474-479), elbow_flex -1.69..1.69 (:453-458), wrist_flex -1.65806..1.65806 (:431-436), wrist_roll -2.74385..2.84121 (:410-415) and gripper -0.174533..1.74533 (:389-394). The clone states the script's individual times but no controller or site bound for a JointTrajectoryPoint Duration, so time_from_start.sec and .nanosec are Limit.operator_required; without a site-limits overlay every call that sets them is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. site-limits.example.json supplies example test values only (0..20 s and 0..999999999 ns); the deployed site supplies its own envelope.

G8 TCAP-003: the action is a fire-and-forget publication with no source-backed state observation, so two different inputs return the identical published/confirmed output and leave the empty main resource unchanged. The driver does not invent a controller acknowledgement or a command-topic echo to create an effect. This is a coverage gap of the selected publication surface; the gate records it in addition to the SAFE-028 stop failure. G8.TOOL_SIZE (the first run's 2561-byte tool) was cleared by shortening the driver-owned descriptions to 2026 bytes; the first run's G4.REF_LINE was a citation beyond moveit_controllers.yaml's 25 lines and is fixed.

NOT COVERED: the /d435i/image image stream and its depth camera array (the upstream object detector consumes it; this package does not implement the SDK image-artifact path and does not claim a camera), the object detector's autonomous detection and grasp logic, /joint_states, TF, /clock, the MoveIt planning/execution actions, the gripper-controller publication, the UDP teleop port, the 20 water-particle models, the container and marking spawns, Gazebo physics and the real controller timing. The image array is therefore NOT COVERED: the /d435i/image image array. The separate /gripper_controller/joint_trajectory publisher (so101_gazebo_bridge.py:18-26) is not backed by a controller in the launched config/controllers.yaml, which defines only the six-joint arm_controller; it is not exposed.

FAKE AND FIDELITY: fake.py is an analytic ROS-free RecordingRosTransport at F0, not a recording of captured traffic: it validates and records the declared advertise and publish only, runs no Gazebo, gz_ros2_control, controller manager, MoveIt or ROS graph, and performs no interpolation, timing, dynamics, gravity, collision or controller error behaviour. The real device size of the camera image is not carried because the camera is out of scope. The upstream scripts' poses, times and status flags are not copied into Facts, Limits or the reference. MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block (HELPER_MISSING): no stop, pause or cancel exists for the /arm_controller/joint_trajectory publication (object_detector.py:5, :14), the teleop bridge's stop only closes its socket, and the gate still fails G6 and G8 (TCAP-003, SAFE-028), stable digest sha256:17911835f0a26b7be70bc133db0f8f81fbb7b50c34f3eb6d13620532bc43d7fe unchanged; the URDF limits and operator_required durations were checked. Defects: the claim that the launched path uses controllers.yaml (a six-joint arm_controller) and that /gripper_controller has no controller is not established: the follower description also loads gz_ros2_control with ros2_controllers.yaml (a five-joint arm_controller plus gripper_controller), and the launch spawns gripper_controller; two other facts said more than their lines. The reviewer corrected three facts, added four, a docstring correction and one gap (driver.py), updated facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Simulated SO-101 arm in Gazebo; no hardware launch in the clone (author's R2 kept). Which arm_controller configuration runs is decided by ros2_control at run time (two ros2_control systems and plugins in the follower URDF, plus a standalone ros2_control_node); six-joint trajectories fit only the six-joint one. The upstream scanning pose commands wrist_flex 1.7 rad, beyond the URDF's 1.65806 (object_detector.py:36).
